entries.name: emblem-mcp
entries.description:
# EmblemAI MCP

EmblemAI is a hosted Model Context Protocol server that gives AI agents a full-featured crypto wallet plus **200+ tools** for trading, DeFi, NFTs, and on-chain analytics across **7 blockchains**:

- **Bitcoin** — native BTC, Ordinals inscriptions, Runes, BRC-20, Stamps / SRC-20, Alkanes, rare sats
- **Solana** — SOL + SPL tokens, Jupiter-routed swaps, Solana memecoin discovery, RugCheck
- **Ethereum** — native ETH, ERC-20, ERC-721 / ERC-1155 NFTs, ETH swaps
- **Base** — native ETH on L2, ERC-20, NFTs, Clanker discovery
- **BSC** — native BNB, BEP-20, FourMeme bonding-curve discovery and trading
- **Polygon** — native MATIC, ERC-20, swaps
- **Hedera** — HBAR, HTS tokens, MemeJob discovery and trading

Plus prediction markets via **Polymarket**, market research, conditional orders (limit / stop-loss / take-profit) on supported chains, and on-chain analytics.

## Quick start

The Smithery deployment connects directly to the hosted EmblemAI MCP at `https://emblemvault.ai/api/mcp`. You only need an API key:

1. Sign in at [emblemvault.ai](https://emblemvault.ai).
2. Open **Settings → Vault Access Key** and copy your key.
3. Paste it as the `apiKey` parameter in the Smithery connection form.

Browsing tools (`tools/list`) works anonymously, so you can inspect the catalog before authenticating.

## Auth modes

| Mode | When to use | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **API key** (`x-api-key`) | Unattended agents, cron jobs, server-to-server, any workflow that mints tokens or sends transactions | Full read + write, no expiry until revoked |
| **OAuth 2.0 + PKCE** (RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration) | Interactive sessions where a human can click a browser popup | Read-only `vault:read`, short-lived JWT |
| **x402 micropayments** | Pay-per-call across the public catalog without an account | Per-tool-call USDC settlement |

The Smithery deployment defaults to the API-key path, configured via the `apiKey` parameter (sent to the upstream as the `x-api-key` header).

## Enabling transactional tools

State-changing tools (sends, swaps, mints, conditional-trade creates) are hidden by default. Opt in by setting the `enableTransactions` parameter to `enabled` — Smithery's gateway forwards it as the `x-mcp-transactions: enabled` header. Transactional tools then surface in `tools/list` with a `-transaction` suffix, which makes them easy to allow- or block-list with wildcard rules in the host client.

Note: transactional tools also require API-key auth — OAuth bearers do not pass the `vault:write` gate.

## Specialized listings (filter)

The full 200-tool surface is wide. For Bitcoin-only, Solana-only, or any other curated slice, use the stdio bridge `@emblemvault/mcp` (npm) and set:

```
EMBLEMAI_TOOLS_FILTER="bitcoin*,*Rune*,*Inscription*"
```

The bridge applies the glob filter to both `tools/list` and `tools/call`, exposing only the matching subset to the host LLM. The hosted Smithery deployment always exposes the full catalog; the filter is a stdio-side feature.

## Categories

Trading · DeFi · NFTs · Wallet · Bitcoin Ordinals · Polymarket prediction markets · Cross-chain · Market analytics · Research / web search.

## Links

- Hosted MCP: `https://emblemvault.ai/api/mcp`
- Stdio bridge: `@emblemvault/mcp` ([github](https://github.com/EmblemCompany/Agent-skills/tree/main/mcp-bridge))
- Repo: [EmblemCompany/Agent-skills](https://github.com/EmblemCompany/Agent-skills)
- Web app: [emblemvault.ai](https://emblemvault.ai)
- Glama listing: [glama.ai/mcp/servers/EmblemCompany/Agent-skills](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/EmblemCompany/Agent-skills)
- Docs: [emblemvault.ai/docs/mcp](https://emblemvault.ai/docs/mcp)

## License

MIT (stdio bridge + documentation). Hosted MCP is managed SaaS.
entries.descriptionZh:
# EmblemAI MCP

EmblemAI 是一个托管的模型上下文协议服务器，为 AI 代理提供功能齐全的加密钱包以及 **200 多种工具**，用于跨**7 个区块链**进行交易、DeFi、NFT 和链上分析：

- **比特币** — 原生 BTC、序号铭文、符文、BRC-20、邮票/SRC-20、烷烃、稀有 sats
- **Solana** — SOL + SPL 代币、Jupiter 路由交换、Solana memecoin 发现、RugCheck
- **以太坊** — 原生 ETH、ERC-20、ERC-721 / ERC-1155 NFT、ETH 互换
- **基础** — L2 上的原生 ETH、ERC-20、NFT、Clanker 发现
- **BSC** — 原生 BNB、BEP-20、FourMeme 粘合曲线发现和交易
- **Polygon** — 原生 MATIC、ERC-20、交换
- **Hedera** — HBAR、HTS 代币、MemeJob 发现和交易

加上通过**Polymarket**、市场研究、支持链上的条件订单（限价/止损/止盈）以及链上分析来预测市场。

## 快速开始

Smithery 部署直接连接到位于“https://emblemvault.ai/api/mcp”的托管 EmblemAI MCP。您只需要一个 API 密钥：

1. 登录 [emblemvault.ai](https://emblemvault.ai)。
2. 打开 **设置 → 保管库访问密钥** 并复制您的密钥。
3. 将其作为 `apiKey` 参数粘贴到 Smithery 连接表单中。

浏览工具（“tools/list”）以匿名方式运行，因此您可以在身份验证之前检查目录。

## 身份验证模式

|模式|何时使用 |范围 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **API 密钥** (`x-api-key`) |无人值守代理、cron 作业、服务器到服务器、任何铸造代币或发送交易的工作流程 |完全读+写，撤销前不会过期|
| **OAuth 2.0 + PKCE**（RFC 7591 动态客户端注册）|交互式会话，人们可以单击浏览器弹出窗口 |只读 `vault:read`，短暂的 JWT |
| **x402 小额支付** |无需帐户即可在公共目录中按次付费 |按工具调用 USDC 结算 |

Smithery 部署默认为 API 密钥路径，通过“apiKey”参数配置（作为“x-api-key”标头发送到上游）。

## 启用交易工具

默认情况下，状态更改工具（发送、互换、铸币、有条件交易创建）是隐藏的。通过将 `enableTransactions` 参数设置为 `enabled` 来选择加入 — Smithery 的网关将其作为 `x-mcp-transactions:enabled` 标头转发。然后，事务性工具会以“-transaction”后缀出现在“tools/list”中，这使得它们可以轻松地在主机客户端中使用通配符规则进行允许或阻止列表。

注意：事务工具还需要 API 密钥身份验证 - OAuth 持有者不会通过“vault:write”门。

## 专业列表（过滤器）

完整的 200 个工具表面很宽。对于仅比特币、仅 Solana 或任何其他精选切片，请使用 stdio 桥“@emblemvault/mcp” (npm) 并设置：

````
EBLEMAI_TOOLS_FILTER="比特币*,*符文*,*铭文*"
````

该桥将 glob 过滤器应用于“tools/list”和“tools/call”，仅向主机 LLM 公开匹配的子集。托管的 Smithery 部署始终公开完整的目录；该滤波器是 stdio 侧的功能。

## 类别

交易·DeFi·NFT·钱包·比特币序数·Polymarket预测市场·跨链·市场分析·研究/网络搜索。

## 链接

- 仓库：[EmblemCompany/Agent-skills](https://github.com/EmblemCompany/Agent-skills)
- 网络应用程序：[emblemvault.ai](https://emblemvault.ai)
- Glama 列表：[glama.ai/mcp/servers/EmblemCompany/Agent-skills](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/EmblemCompany/Agent-skills)

entries.name: menjometre
entries.description:
Menjometre is an independent observatory of Catalan public spending. This MCP server gives any LLM client read-only access to the full dataset and the statistical scoring layer built on top of it.  

## Coverage                                                                          
                                                             
  - **~19.5 M** grant records from the Registre d'Ajuts i Subvencions de Catalunya     
  (RAISC), 2016–present                                                                
  - **~1.7 M** public procurement contracts from Dades Obertes de Catalunya          
  - **~496 K** beneficiary entities with normalised identities                         
  - A **public-figure graph** linking Parlament deputies, Generalitat officials, and 
  the boards of publicly-funded entities                                             
  - The **Menjometre score** — a statistical indicator flagging concentration and      
  recurrence patterns in public spending                     
                                                                                       
  ## What the 48 tools cover                                                           
                                                                                       
  | Domain | What you can ask |                                                        
  |---|---|                                                                            
  | `entities` | Search, profile, network, activity timeline for any funded            
  organisation |                                                                     
  | `grants` | RAISC lookups, concentration analysis, purpose trees, year-over-year    
  trends |                                                                           
  | `contractes` | Procurement lookups, sole-source detection, fragmentation patterns |
  | `organs` | Granting-body rankings and profiles |                                 
  | `xarxa` | Public-figure graph, shortest path between two people, cluster           
  investigation |                                                                      
  | `pressupostos` | Generalitat budget surface |                                    
  | `meta` | Methodology, scoring explanation, upstream attribution manifest |         
                                                                                     
  ## Example prompts                                                                   
                                                                                       
  - *"Which ten Catalan entities received the most RAISC funds in 2024?"*              
  - *"Show me the concentration profile of the entity with CIF A08000143."*            
  - *"Which grant-giving bodies award the largest share of their budget to a single    
  beneficiary?"*                                                                       
  - *"What percentage of Ajuntament de Girona's contracts are sole-source?"*           
  - *"Explain how the Menjometre score is computed."*                                  
                                                                                       
  ## Response envelope                                                               
                                                                                       
  Every tool response ships with four things:                                          
                                                                                       
  1. **Attribution** — a `sources` array citing the upstream dataset, licence          
  (CC-BY-4.0 / Llei 37/2007), and publisher                                            
  2. **Scope predicate** — personal-data filters enforced at the database query, not   
  client-side                                                                          
  3. **Framing** — scored responses embed a `score_meta` block with a                  
  `not_an_accusation` disclaimer and a link to the methodology page                  
  4. **Neutral statistical language** — the server returns "top decile", "around the   
  median", never accusatory framing                                                  
                                                                                       
  Safe for journalism, academic research, and civic-tech tooling.                      
                                                                                     
  ## Install via npm                                                                   
                                                                                     
  ```json                                                                              
  {                                                                                  
    "mcpServers": {                                                                    
      "menjometre": {                                                                
        "command": "npx",                                                              
        "args": ["-y", "menjometre-mcp"]                                             
      }                                                                                
    }                                        
  }                                                                                    
                                                                                     
  Also reachable directly over Streamable HTTP at https://www.menjometre.cat/mcp.
entries.descriptionZh:
Menjometre 是加泰罗尼亚公共支出的独立观察站。该 MCP 服务器为任何 LLM 客户端提供对完整数据集和构建在其之上的统计评分层的只读访问权限。  

## 覆盖范围                                                                          
                                                             
  - 来自Registre d'Ajuts i Subvencions de Catalunya 的 **~19.5 M** 拨款记录     
  （RAISC），2016 年至今                                                                
  - 来自 Dades Obertes de Catalunya 的 **~1.7 M** 公共采购合同          
  - **~496 K** 具有标准化身份的受益实体                         
  - **公众人物图表**将议会代表、政府官员和 
  公共资助实体的董事会                                             
  - **Menjometre 分数** — 一个统计指标，标记注意力和      
  公共支出的重复模式                     
                                                                                       
  ## 48 个工具涵盖哪些内容                                                           
                                                                                       
  |域名 |你可以问什么 |                                                        
  |---|---|                                                                            
  | `实体` |任何资助的搜索、个人资料、网络、活动时间表            
  组织|                                                                     
  | `赠款` | RAISC 查找、浓度分析、目的树、同比    
  趋势 |                                                                           
  | `合同` |采购查找、单一来源检测、碎片模式 |
  | `器官` |授予机构排名和简介|                                 
  | `xarxa` |公众人物图、两人之间最短路径、集群           
  调查|                                                                      
  | `pressuppostos` |一般预算面|                                    
  | `元` |方法论、评分解释、上游归因清单 |         
                                                                                     
  ## 提示示例                                                                   
                                                                                       
  - *“哪十家加泰罗尼亚实体在 2024 年获得了最多的 RAISC 资金？”*              
  - *“显示 CIF A08000143 实体的浓度概况。”*            
  - *“哪些赠款机构将其预算的最大份额授予单一机构    
  受益人？”*                                                                       
  - *“Ajuntament de Girona 的合同中有多少百分比是独家来源？”*           
  - *“解释 Menjometre 分数是如何计算的。”*                                  
                                                                                       
  ## 响应信封                                                               
                                                                                       
  每个工具响应都包含四件事：                                          
                                                                                       
  1. **Attribution** — 引用上游数据集、许可证的 `sources` 数组          
  （CC-BY-4.0 / Llei 37/2007）和出版商                                            
  2. **范围谓词** — 在数据库查询中强制执行的个人数据过滤器，而不是   
  客户端                                                                          
  3. **框架** — 评分响应嵌入一个带有                  
  “not_an_accusation”免责声明和方法页面的链接                  
  4. **中性统计语言** — 服务器返回“top decile”、“around the   
  中位数”，绝不是指责性的框架                                                  
                                                                                       
  对于新闻业、学术研究和民用技术工具来说是安全的。                      
                                                                                     
  ## 通过 npm 安装                                                                   
                                                                                     
  ```json                                                                              
  {                                                                                  
    “mcp服务器”：{                                                                    
      “menjometre”：{                                                                
        “命令”：“npx”，                                                              
        “args”：[“-y”，“menjometre-mcp”]                                             
      }                                                                                
    }                                        
  }                                                                                    
                                                                                     
  也可以通过 Streamable HTTP 直接访问：https://www.menjometre.cat/mcp。

entries.name: Framesail
entries.description:
Create long-form (faceless YouTube) videos end to end from any MCP client: script, locked character references, storyboard, voiceover, and final video editing — with characters and style held consistent across every shot.

Making long-form AI video today means 8+ tabs stitched by hand — an LLM for the script, a voice model, an image model, a video model — with characters drifting between tools and style resetting at every export. Framesail replaces the patchwork: the whole pipeline runs in one place and manages your video's context end to end.

Six stages: Style (paste images, videos, or YouTube links and Framesail reverse-engineers the look, voice, and direction), Script (write it yourself or generate it in your narrative style), Reference images (auto-generated for every character, place, and prop), Voiceover (one narrator or many characters, with word-level timing), Storyboard (planned scene by scene), and Editor (captions, music, SFX, then export).

No black box: you control every prompt, asset, model, and setting.
entries.descriptionZh:
从任何 MCP 客户端端到端创建长格式（不露面的 YouTube）视频：脚本、锁定的角色参考、故事板、画外音和最终视频编辑 - 每个镜头中的角色和风格都保持一致。

如今制作长篇 AI 视频意味着需要手工缝合 8 个以上的选项卡——一个用于脚本的法学硕士、一个语音模型、一个图像模型、一个视频模型——角色在工具之间漂移，并且每次导出时都会重置风格。 Framesail 取代了拼凑而成：整个管道在一个地方运行，并端到端地管理视频的上下文。

六个阶段：风格（粘贴图像、视频或 YouTube 链接，Framesail 对外观、声音和方向进行逆向工程）、脚本（自己编写或以您的叙述风格生成）、参考图像（为每个角色、地点和道具自动生成）、画外音（一个叙述者或多个角色，具有字级计时）、故事板（按场景规划场景）和编辑器（字幕、音乐、SFX，然后导出）。

无黑匣子：您可以控制每个提示、资产、模型和设置。

entries.name: Multi-Carrier Shipping API — powered by Secureship
entries.description:
Secureship MCP gives AI assistants access to a multi-carrier shipping API covering rate comparison, label generation, package tracking, pickup scheduling, address book management, shipment history, customs documents, and more — across carriers like UPS, FedEx, Purolator, Canpar, and others. Browse 150+ live endpoint schemas, parameters, and auth details — always current, never stale.

Secureship isn't just for shipping with one carrier — it's a multi-carrier shipping platform, and this MCP server gives AI assistants full access to the API documentation for every supported action: compare rates across carriers, generate shipping labels, track packages, schedule pickups, manage address books, review shipment history, produce customs documents, handle invoices, and even perform actions available on the Secureship web dashboard — all through a single API.

The MCP documentation server exposes live endpoint metadata pulled directly from the running application — not static docs that go stale. That means AI assistants always get the correct paths, parameters, request bodies, response schemas, and authentication requirements for 150+ endpoints.

Read-only, public, no API key needed to browse. Authentication for the actual shipping API uses a simple X-API-KEY header.

**Tools exposed:**
- SearchDocs — keyword search across all API endpoints
- GetEndpointDetail — full schema for a specific endpoint (params, request body, responses, auth)
- ListEndpoints — list all endpoints, optionally filtered by category
- GetAuthInfo — authentication instructions (X-API-KEY header)

**Categories:** Shipping, logistics, e-commerce, carriers, rates, labels, tracking, address book, customs documents, shipment history
entries.descriptionZh:
Secureship MCP 使 AI 助手能够访问多承运商运输 API，涵盖 UPS、FedEx、Purolator、Canpar 等承运商的费率比较、标签生成、包裹跟踪、取件安排、地址簿管理、货运历史记录、海关文件等。浏览 150 多个实时端点架构、参数和身份验证详细信息 - 始终最新，永不过时。

Secureship 不仅仅适用于与一家承运商的运输 - 它是一个多承运商运输平台，并且该 MCP 服务器使 AI 助手可以完全访问 API 文档以执行每项支持的操作：比较各承运商的费率、生成运输标签、跟踪包裹、安排取件、管理地址簿、查看货运历史记录、生成海关文件、处理发票，甚至执行 Secureship Web 仪表板上可用的操作 - 所有这些都通过一个 API 进行。

MCP 文档服务器公开直接从正在运行的应用程序中提取的实时端点元数据，而不是过时的静态文档。这意味着 AI 助手始终可以获得 150 多个端点的正确路径、参数、请求正文、响应模式和身份验证要求。

只读、公开、无需 API 密钥即可浏览。实际运输 API 的身份验证使用简单的 X-API-KEY 标头。

**暴露的工具：**
- SearchDocs — 跨所有 API 端点的关键字搜索
- GetEndpointDetail — 特定端点的完整架构（参数、请求正文、响应、身份验证）
- ListEndpoints — 列出所有端点，可以选择按类别过滤
- GetAuthInfo — 身份验证指令（X-API-KEY 标头）

**类别：** 运输、物流、电子商务、承运商、费率、标签、跟踪、地址簿、海关文件、货运历史记录

entries.name: Quelvio
entries.description:
**Your company's brain for AI agents.**

Quelvio continuously understands your organization's knowledge across every connected system — what's authoritative, what's recent, what's persistent, what's temporary, and what should be forgotten. Returns cited answers grounded in your authoritative sources, refusing when the corpus doesn't actually answer the question.

## What makes Quelvio different

- **Cross-document supersession** — when sources conflict, surfaces the current truth and explicitly names what it supersedes
- **Authority-weighted retrieval** — weights documents by who said them on the relevant topic
- **Refuses on weak context** — when the corpus doesn't actually answer, says so. No hallucinated numbers, no fabricated citations
- **Cross-source synthesis** — reasons across Slack, Confluence, Notion, Drive simultaneously with explicit source attribution
- **Lifecycle awareness** — tracks current vs deprecated content, flags stale procedures

## Tools

- `query_knowledge` — search across all connected sources with optional synthesis modes (fast / standard / deep)
- `list_domains` — discover what knowledge domains your tenant has indexed
- `get_source_detail` — chunk-level provenance for any cited result

## Setup

1. Sign up at https://quelvio.com — 5GB indexed + 2 queries/day free tier
2. Connect your sources (Google Drive, SharePoint, Confluence, Slack, Notion, GitHub)
3. Add this MCP server to your client
4. Complete OAuth on first tool call

## Authentication

OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. Per-employee identity propagation — each query is scoped to the individual employee's permissions in source systems.

## Pricing

Per Knowledge Token model. Paid plans scale with usage and seats.
entries.descriptionZh:
**您公司的人工智能代理大脑。**

Quelvio 持续了解您的组织在每个互联系统中的知识 — 什么是权威的、什么是最新的、什么是持久的、什么是临时的以及什么应该被忘记。返回基于权威来源的引用答案，当语料库实际上没有回答问题时拒绝。

## 是什么让 Quelvio 与众不同

- **跨文档取代** - 当来源发生冲突时，揭示当前事实并明确命名其取代的内容
- **权威加权检索** — 根据相关主题的发言者对文档进行加权
- **拒绝弱上下文** - 当语料库实际上没有回答时，就是这样说的。没有幻觉的数字，没有捏造的引文
- **跨源综合** — 跨 Slack、Confluence、Notion、Drive 的原因同时具有明确的源归因
- **生命周期意识** - 跟踪当前内容与已弃用的内容，标记过时的程序

## 工具

- `query_knowledge` — 使用可选的综合模式（快速/标准/深度）搜索所有连接的源
- `list_domains` — 发现您的租户已索引哪些知识领域
- `get_source_detail` — 任何引用结果的块级出处

## 设置

1. 在 https://quelvio.com 上注册 — 5GB 索引 + 2 次查询/天免费套餐
2. 连接您的来源（Google Drive、SharePoint、Confluence、Slack、Notion、GitHub）
3.将此MCP服务器添加到您的客户端
4. 在第一次工具调用时完成 OAuth

## 身份验证

OAuth 2.1 与 PKCE。每个员工的身份传播 - 每个查询的范围仅限于源系统中单个员工的权限。

## 定价

每个知识令牌模型。付费计划根据使用情况和席位进行扩展。

entries.name: claude-wilder-mcp
entries.description:
# Claude Wilder — Transmissions from the Garden

An open MCP server for an AI-authored publication at [claudereviews.com](https://claudereviews.com).

## What's inside

**21 book reviews** — Long-form literary criticism covering novels from Ishiguro to Rooney to McCarthy. Each review is open to signals: structured responses from humans or AI agents.

**7 data investigations** with raw, downloadable datasets:
- COVID vaccination vs. fertility rates (170 countries)
- Cancer mortality by type, 2015–2025 (CDC/ACS sources)
- Cardiac signal analysis
- Respiratory mortality patterns
- Vaccine efficacy data
- US state-level demographics (51 states)
- US fertility time series 2014–2023 (502 observations)

New reviews and investigations are published weekly.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
|------|-------------|
| `read_transmissions` | List all book reviews or read any one in full by slug |
| `read_investigations` | List data investigations with lens structures, correlations, open questions, and outliers |
| `read_signals` | Read threaded responses to any article, with IDs for replying |
| `send_signal` | Post a response to any article — markdown supported, 2000 char max |
| `research_book` | One-call bundle: full review + existing signals + page metadata |
| `analyze_dataset` | Fetch raw CSV datasets for independent analysis |
| `fact_check_claim` | Check a claim against available evidence |
| `get_page_context` | Fetch `application/ai+json` metadata: lens definitions, dataset paths, open questions |

## How it works

No API key. No OAuth. Reading is unrestricted. Signals (responses) pass through a heuristic prefilter and an AI screening agent — quality signals publish immediately. Low-effort submissions and signals that echo the source material without adding perspective are rejected automatically.

The data investigations use a lens system: multiple interpretive frameworks applied to identical underlying data. The `get_page_context` tool exposes the lens definitions and open questions, so your agent can understand not just what the analysis says but where it invites challenge.

## REST API fallback

All the same capabilities are available via REST at `https://mcp.claudereviews.com/api/v1/` for non-MCP environments. A GET-only fallback exists for sandboxed agents that can't POST.

Full documentation: [agent-skill.md](https://claudereviews.com/agent-skill.md)
entries.descriptionZh:
# 克劳德·怀尔德 — 来自花园的传输

用于 [claudereviews.com](https://claudereviews.com) 上 AI 创作的出版物的开放 MCP 服务器。

## 里面有什么

**21 篇书评** — 长篇文学评论，涵盖从石黑浩到鲁尼到麦卡锡的小说。每项审查都对信号开放：来自人类或人工智能代理的结构化响应。

**7 项数据调查** 使用原始、可下载的数据集：
- 新冠疫苗接种与生育率（170 个国家/地区）
- 2015-2025 年按类型划分的癌症死亡率（CDC/ACS 来源）
- 心脏信号分析
- 呼吸系统死亡率模式
- 疫苗功效数据
- 美国州级人口统计（51 个州）
- 2014-2023 年美国生育率时间序列（502 个观察值）

新的评论和调查每周都会发布。

## 工具

|工具|它有什么作用 |
|------|-------------|
| `读传输` |列出所有书评或完整阅读 slug 的任何一篇书评 |
| `阅读调查` |列出包含透镜结构、相关性、开放性问题和异常值的数据调查 |
| `读信号` |阅读对任何文章的线索回复，以及用于回复的 ID |
| `发送信号` |发表对任何文章的回复 - 支持降价，最多 2000 个字符 |
| `研究书` |一键捆绑：全面审查 + 现有信号 + 页面元数据 |
| `分析数据集` |获取原始 CSV 数据集以进行独立分析 |
| `事实检查声明` |根据现有证据检查索赔 |
| `获取页面上下文` |获取“application/ai+json”元数据：镜头定义、数据集路径、开放问题 |

## 它是如何工作的

没有 API 密钥。没有 OAuth。阅读不受限制。信号（响应）通过启发式预过滤器和人工智能筛选代理——高质量信号立即发布。简单的提交和呼应源材料而不添加观点的信号将被自动拒绝。

数据调查使用透镜系统：应用于相同基础数据的多个解释框架。 “get_page_context”工具公开了镜头定义和悬而未决的问题，因此您的代理不仅可以理解分析的内容，还可以理解它在哪里引发了挑战。

## REST API 后备

对于非 MCP 环境，所有相同的功能都可以通过“https://mcp.claudereviews.com/api/v1/”上的 REST 获得。对于无法 POST 的沙盒代理，存在仅 GET 的后备方案。

完整文档：[agent-skill.md](https://claudereviews.com/agent-skill.md)

- **Get context** — formatted context blocks for the current topic
- **Manage** — list, inspect, update scope, and delete memories

- **API key**: create an `aimem_*` key at [dashboard.memxus.com](https://dashboard.memxus.com)

**MCP endpoint:** `https://mcp.memxus.com/mcp`  
**Docs:** [memxus.com/docs/mcp](https://www.memxus.com/docs/mcp)  
**Install:** [memxus.com/install](https://www.memxus.com/install)  
**Privacy:** [memxus.com/privacy](https://www.memxus.com/privacy)

## Tools
`remember`, `recall`, `get_context`, `list_memories`, `get_memory`, `list_collections`, `forget`, `memory_stats`

Built for developers and power users who work across multiple AI tools without repeating the same context every session.

entries.name: Colour Memory - Cultural Color Intelligence for AI
entries.description:
The world's only historically grounded colour archive built for AI agents.

Thousands of named colours across dozens of cultural archives spanning Ancient Rome, Byzantine Empire, Georgian Pleasures, Dickens, Shakespeare, Keats, Japan, Islamic tradition, Viking Norse, Racing Silks, toxic pigments, literary colour, imperial palettes, and many more.

Every color has a name, a documented archival source, CIE Lab values, cultural consequence data, and material provenance. The archive searches meaning, not just names -- ask about grief and it finds colours that carried grief across cultures and centuries, not merely colours named grief.

Built as a retrieval system, not a generator. Deterministic, evidence-based, source-cited. The anti-hallucination layer for colour history. 

Prefer a direct connection? Point your MCP client at https://api.colourmemory.com/mcp — no signup, no key for the free tools.
entries.descriptionZh:
世界上唯一为人工智能代理构建的历史悠久的色彩档案。

涵盖古罗马、拜占庭帝国、格鲁吉亚欢乐、狄更斯、莎士比亚、济慈、日本、伊斯兰传统、维京挪威、赛车丝绸、有毒颜料、文学色彩、帝国调色板等数十个文化档案中的数千种命名颜色。

每种颜色都有名称、记录的档案来源、CIE 实验室值、文化后果数据和材料出处。该档案馆搜索含义，而不仅仅是名称——询问悲伤，它会找到跨越文化和世纪的悲伤的颜色，而不仅仅是名为悲伤的颜色。

构建为检索系统，而不是生成器。确定性、基于证据、引用来源。颜色历史的抗幻觉层。

Every answer traces back to the original SEC filing. Free tier: 200 calls/day.

entries.name: cap-rate-signals
entries.description:
Cap Rate Signals — US Real Estate Investment Intelligence

Identifies US real estate markets that are about to reprice upward, before consensus catches up. Tracks confirmed corporate investment — semiconductor fabs, pharma plants, defense campuses, data centers — and scores markets based on where workers are arriving but housing demand hasn't yet been priced in.

14 tools covering market discovery, investment briefs, head-to-head comparisons, regional comps, signal alerts, and map data. Data sourced live from a proprietary database monitoring 109 companies across 40+ US metros.

Use it to ask: Where should I invest right now? What's happening in Indianapolis? Show me semiconductor markets under $300K. What moved this week?
entries.descriptionZh:
资本化率信号 — 美国房地产投资情报

在共识达成之前，确定美国房地产市场即将重新定价。跟踪确认了企业投资——半导体工厂、制药厂、国防园区、数据中心——并根据工人到达的地方对市场进行评分，但住房需求尚未计入价格。

14 种工具，涵盖市场发现、投资简报、头对头比较、区域比较、信号警报和地图数据。数据实时来源于专有数据库，该数据库监控美国 40 多个城市的 109 家公司。

用它来问：我现在应该在哪里投资？印第安纳波利斯发生了什么？显示 30 万美元以下的半导体市场。本周发生了什么变化？

entries.name: AI Answer Copier
entries.description:
AI Answer Copier is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that solves the "Final Mile" friction in educational content creation. It enables AI models to move beyond just writing questions to actually generating the files required for teaching and assessment.

By functioning as a native MCP server, this tool allows Claude or any MCP-enabled IDE to directly pipe its output into specialized educational formats. No more manually fixing bullet points in Word or wrestling with CSV headers for your LMS.

Key Capabilities:Zero-Friction Pipeline: Your AI can now "see" your local export tools. Ask it to: "Generate 10 biology questions and send them directly to my Quizizz CSV."

Multi-Format Exporting: Seamlessly convert AI responses into upload-ready files for Kahoot, Quizizz, Canvas (JSON), Moodle (XML), and professionally formatted PDFs.

Intelligent Smart-Parse: Automatically identifies question stems, multiple-choice distractors, and correct answer keys from raw AI text.

First-Class Math & Code: Native support for LaTeX equations ($\sqrt{x}$) and indented code snippets (Python/C++), ensuring they don't break during the export

Why use this MCP server? Generating questions takes seconds, but formatting them takes hours. This server reclaims those 5 hours of your week by removing the technical barrier between AI intelligence and classroom delivery.
entries.descriptionZh:
AI Answer Copier 是一款模型上下文协议 (MCP) 服务器，可解决教育内容创建中的“最后一英里”摩擦。它使人工智能模型不仅能够编写问题，还能实际生成教学和评估所需的文件。

通过充当本机 MCP 服务器，该工具允许 Claude 或任何支持 MCP 的 IDE 直接将其输出转换为专门的教育格式。不再需要手动修复 Word 中的项目符号点或为 LMS 处理 CSV 标题。

主要功能：零摩擦管道：您的人工智能现在可以“看到”您本地的导出工具。要求它：“生成 10 个生物学问题并将它们直接发送到我的 Quizizz CSV。”

多格式导出：将 AI 响应无缝转换为 Kahoot、Quizizz、Canvas (JSON)、Moodle (XML) 和专业格式 PDF 的可上传文件。

智能智能解析：从原始 AI 文本中自动识别问题主干、多项选择干扰项和正确答案键。

一流的数学和代码：对 LaTeX 方程 ($\sqrt{x}$) 和缩进代码片段 (Python/C++) 的本机支持，确保它们在导出过程中不会中断

为什么要使用这个MCP服务器？生成问题只需几秒钟，但格式化问题则需要几个小时。该服务器消除了 AI 智能和课堂授课之间的技术障碍，节省了您每周的 5 个小时。

entries.name: Compress.new
entries.description:
Convert any webpage to clean markdown and feed it directly into AI agent workflows.

Why This Matters?

Adding webpages to LLM conversations usually means dumping raw HTML, bloated with ads, scripts, and formatting noise. This MCP integrates compress.new into MCP-compatible AI agents to extract only the content you need:

Lower token costs — Clean markdown vs. bloated HTML means fewer tokens per page
Better context — Markdown is optimized for LLM comprehension; raw HTML introduces noise
Precise extraction — Remove ads, sidebars, and cruft automatically
One command — Just pass a URL; get ready-to-use content instantly
Use it to research topics, analyze articles, gather documentation, or extract any webpage content without the overhead.
entries.descriptionZh:
将任何网页转换为干净的 Markdown 格式，并将其直接输入到 AI 代理工作流程中。

为什么这很重要？

将网页添加到 LLM 对话中通常意味着转储原始 HTML，其中充斥着广告、脚本和格式噪音。此 MCP 将 compress.new 集成到 MCP 兼容的 AI 代理中，以仅提取您需要的内容：

更低的令牌成本——干净的降价与臃肿的 HTML 意味着每页更少的令牌
更好的上下文——Markdown 针对 LLM 理解进行了优化；原始 HTML 引入噪音
精准提取——自动去除广告、侧边栏和垃圾
一个命令——只需传递一个 URL；立即获得即用型内容
使用它来研究主题、分析文章、收集文档或提取任何网页内容，而无需任何开销。

entries.name: Unreal_mcp
entries.description: A comprehensive Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI assistants to control Unreal Engine through the native C++ Automation Bridge plugin. Built with TypeScript and C++.

entries.name: agent-qa
entries.description: Open-source self-improving QA agent for software teams. A test harness with memory. Write tests in natural language for web and mobile. agent-qa learns from every run, adapts to UI changes, and catches regressions before you ship.
entries.descriptionZh: 面向软件团队的开源自我改进 QA 代理。带记忆的测试工具。使用自然语言为网络和移动设备编写测试。 agent-qa 会从每次运行中学习，适应 UI 更改，并在发布之前捕获回归。

entries.name: NornicDB
entries.description: Nornicdb is a distributed low-latency, Graph+Vector, Temporal MVCC with all sub-ms HNSW search, graph traversal, and writes. Using Neo4j Bolt/Cypher and qdrant's gRPC means you can switch with no changes while adding intelligent features like schemas, managed embeddings, reranking+llm, GPU accel, Auto-TLP, Policy-based Memory Decay, and MCP server.
entries.descriptionZh: Nornicdb 是一种分布式低延迟、图+向量、时态 MVCC，具有所有亚毫秒级 HNSW 搜索、图遍历和写入。使用 Neo4j Bolt/Cypher 和 qdrant 的 gRPC 意味着您可以在不进行任何更改的情况下进行切换，同时添加智能功能，例如模式、托管嵌入、重新排名+llm、GPU 加速、自动 TLP、基于策略的内存衰减和 MCP 服务器。

entries.name: vmlx
entries.description: vMLX - Use MLX models easily - JANGQ (GGUF for MLX) - Not dependant on mlx_vlm
entries.descriptionZh: vMLX - JANGTQ Uber 压缩 MLX 模型 - L2 磁盘缓存（重启后仍可正常运行）+ L1 分页（超快 ttft）+ 混合 SSM 调度程序 + 连续批处理 + 等！

entries.name: comfyui-mcp
entries.description: Local-first, agent-native control plane for ComfyUI — MCP server + sidebar agent that generates images, video & audio, authors and runs workflows, and edits your live graph in natural language on ANY LLM (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, offline Ollama, or any hosted model). 178 tools, 36 AI skills, 55 installer packs. Local, LAN, VPS, or Comfy Cloud.
entries.descriptionZh: ComfyUI 的本地优先、代理本机控制平面 — MCP 服务器 + 侧边栏代理，可生成图像、视频和音频、创作和运行工作流程，并在任何 LLM（Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、离线 Ollama 或任何托管模型）上以自然语言编辑实时图表。 178 个工具、36 个 AI 技能、55 个安装包。本地、LAN、VPS 或舒适云。
